- **Natural Language Processing Pipeline**
  - Built end-to-end NLP pipeline for text classification using **BERT**, **RoBERTa**, and **DistilBERT** models.
  - Preprocessed and cleaned 100K+ text documents using **spaCy** and **NLTK** for tokenization and entity recognition.
  - Implemented attention mechanisms and transfer learning to achieve 88% accuracy on multi-class classification tasks.
  - Deployed the model as a REST API using **FastAPI**, handling 1000+ requests per second in production.
